en: The ledger's own row is excluded from the diff, and this is the least obvious part of the design. The evidence is <t1>about</t1> the tree rather than part of what the tests measure, so its own row must not age the proof it records. Without the exclusion <t2/> is unreachable by construction: recording writes the ledger and therefore dirties the tree, and committing the record moves HEAD past the commit the record names, so the strongest state could never be reached by the act that produces the evidence for it. en: The cache lives under <t1/>, beside the shared server's lease and for the same reason: it belongs to this checkout, is never tracked, and a fresh clone starts without it. It holds counts, recipe names and their descriptions, and toolchain version strings — nothing read from the process environment, no file contents, no path outside the repository. Each tier carries its own fingerprint over its own inputs, so editing the justfile expires the workflows and leaves the counts alone. A cache that cannot be read is a miss, never an error, and writes are atomic. A served request — HTTP or MCP — never writes it: the cache is the command line's, and a <t2/> with a side effect on the repository would be a defect.

Obsahuje počty, názvy receptů s jejich popisy a řetězce verzí toolchainu — nic načtené z prostředí procesu, žádný obsah souborů, žádnou cestu mimo repozitář. Každá úroveň nese vlastní otisk nad svými vstupy, takže úprava justfile zneplatní workflow a počty nechá být. Cache, kterou nelze přečíst, je minutí, nikdy chyba, a zápisy jsou atomické. en: Owner 2026-10-17: a watchdog must make sure the mesh runs, tasks drain and nobody waits for a timeout. The 10-17 design's phase S0/S1 is exactly a view without action; idle waiting for CI must not read as stuck. The 09-15 design asked for a cooperation doctor listing stale peers, orphan leases and unverified completions. Critique 10-18: the execution store lives only in memory and ExecutionPolicy declares no bound, so the bound has to be declared and the classification narrowed to live servers. The owner's 'no leaks' and the 10-17 design's S1 (stalls, resource leaks, blocked queues) need resource classes, not only item classes. Proposed in ADR <n1/> (Supervision repairs only what is idempotent, owned and verified, and never restarts blindly) (proposed; it carries no authority until the owner accepts it). Sources: chatgpt-majordomus:c288#16, chatgpt-majordomus:c145#5.
cs: Vlastník 2026-10-17: watchdog musí zajistit, že mesh běží, úlohy se vyprazdňují a nikdo nečeká na timeout. Fáze S0/S1 návrhu z 10-17 je přesně pohled bez akce; nečinné čekání na CI se nesmí číst jako uvíznutí. Návrh z 09-15 žádal cooperation doctor vypisující zastaralé peery, osiřelé lease a neověřená dokončení. Kritika 10-18: úložiště provedení žije jen v paměti a ExecutionPolicy nedeklaruje žádnou mez, takže mez se musí deklarovat a klasifikace zúžit na živé servery. 'No leaks' vlastníka a S1 z návrhu 10-17 (uvíznutí, úniky zdrojů, blokované fronty) potřebují třídy zdrojů, nejen třídy položek. Navrženo v ADR <n1/> (Supervize opravuje jen to, co je idempotentní, vlastněné a ověřené, a nikdy nerestartuje naslepo) (proposed; nemá žádnou autoritu, dokud ho vlastník nepřijme). Zdroje: chatgpt-majordomus:c288#16, chatgpt-majordomus:c145#5.
